The 5251 vs 4558 gap is 693 rows, which is plausible for 30 duplicated customers. The fix is to keep only current rows in silver_customers. Every one of the 200 customers has exactly one is_current=True row (True count is 200, with 200 distinct customers), so filtering on it gives one row per customer. The question is whether region should be the current region or the region as of the transaction date. The old rows have valid_from 2023-06-01 and the current rows have valid_from 2025-01-01. All transactions are from January 2026, which is after both valid_from dates, so the current row applies to every transaction. Filtering to is_current is therefore correct. silver_customers keeps its columns (customer_id, region).
